69757-dawn-in-darkest-africa.title: Africa
69757-dawn-in-darkest-africa.creator: John H. Harris
69757-dawn-in-darkest-africa.description: A book by John H. Harris. a noble cause, cannot, however, for one moment be allowed to outweigh the immense benefits conferred on civilization by missionary and philanthropic agencies. Nowhere have these benefits been more conspicuous than in the case of the Congo.

arxiv-2007-05045.title: Contact lines on stretched soft solids: Modeling anisotropic surface stresses
arxiv-2007-05045.creator: Stefanie Heyden, Nicolas Bain, Qin Xu, Robert W. Style, Eric R. Dufresne
arxiv-2007-05045.description: Abstract We present fully analytical solutions for the deformation of a stretched soft substrate due to the static wetting of a large liquid droplet, and compare our solutions to recently published experiments (Xu et al , Soft Matter 2018). Following a Green’s function approach, we extend the surface-stress regularized Flamant-Cerruti problem to account for uniaxial pre-strains of the substrate.

arxiv-2111-07681.title: Finite-Time Dynamical Phase Transition in Non-Equilibrium Relaxation
arxiv-2111-07681.creator: Jan Meibohm, Massimiliano Esposito
arxiv-2111-07681.description: Abstract We uncover a finite-time dynamical phase transition in the thermal relaxation of a mean-field magnetic model. The phase transition manifests itself as a cusp singularity in the probability distribution of the magnetisation that forms at a critical time. The transition is due to a sudden switch in the dynamics, characterised by a dynamical order parameter.

arxiv-2202-02348.title: Explicit Reciprocity Laws for Formal Drinfeld Modules
arxiv-2202-02348.creator: Marwa Ala Eddine Université de Bourgogne Franche-Comté, Laboratoire de Mathématique de Besançon, 25030 Besançon, France. E-mail: marwa.ala_eddine@univ-fcomte.fr , ORCID: 0000-0001-6911-0580
arxiv-2202-02348.description: Abstract . In this paper, we prove explicit reciprocity laws for a class of formal Drinfeld modules having stable reduction of height one, in the spirit of those existing in characteristic zero (cf. the work of Wiles [ 7 ] ).

arxiv-2206-15454.title: Near-wall approximations to speed up simulations for atmosphere boundary layers in the presence of forests using lattice Boltzmann method on GPU
arxiv-2206-15454.creator: Xinyuan Shao, Marta Camps Santasmasas, Xiao Xue, Jiqiang Niu, Lars Davidson, Alistair J. Revell, Hua-Dong Yao
arxiv-2206-15454.description: Abstract Forests play an important role in influencing the wind resource in atmospheric boundary layers and the fatigue life of wind turbines. Due to turbulence, a difficulty in the simulation of the forest effects is that flow statistical and fluctuating content should be accurately resolved using a turbulence-resolved CFD method, which requires a large amount of computing time and resources.

arxiv-2209-04323.title: Operators on Herz-type spaces associated with ball quasi-Banach function spaces
arxiv-2209-04323.creator: Mingquan Wei ∗, Dunyan Yan
arxiv-2209-04323.description: Abstract . Let α ∈ ℝ \alpha\in\mathbb{R} , 0 < p < ∞ 0<p<\infty and X X be a ball quasi-Banach function space on ℝ n \mathbb{R}^{n} . In this article, we introduce the Herz-type space K ˙ X α , p ​ ( ℝ n ) \dot{K}^{\alpha,p}_{X}(\mathbb{R}^{n}) associated with X X .

arxiv-2210-03030.title: Learning many-body Hamiltonians with Heisenberg-limited scaling
arxiv-2210-03030.creator: Hsin-Yuan Huang, Yu Tong, Di Fang, Yuan Su
arxiv-2210-03030.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Hsin-Yuan Huang, Yu Tong, Di Fang, Yuan Su. Learning a many-body Hamiltonian from its dynamics is a fundamental problem in physics. In this work, we propose the first algorithm to achieve the Heisenberg limit for learning an interacting N N -qubit local Hamiltonian. After a total evolution time of 𝒪 ⁡ ( ϵ − 1 ) \mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-1}) , the proposed algorithm can efficiently estimate any parameter in the N N -qubit Hamiltonian to ϵ \epsilon -error with high probability.

arxiv-2306-00772.title: Manipulating spatial structure of high-order quantum coherence with entangled photons
arxiv-2306-00772.creator: Shuang-Yin Huang, 1,2 Jing Gao, 1,2 Zhi-Cheng Ren, 1,2 Zi-Mo Cheng, 1,2 Wen-Zheng Zhu, 1,2 Shu-Tian Xue, 1,2 Yan-Chao Lou, 1,2 Zhi-Feng Liu, 1,2 Chao Chen, 1,2 Fei Zhu, 3 Li-Ping Yang, 4 Xi-Lin Wang, 1,2,5,6 and Hui-Tian Wang 1,2,7
arxiv-2306-00772.description: Abstract High-order quantum coherence reveals the statistical correlation of quantum particles. Manipulation of quantum coherence of light in temporal domain enables to produce single-photon source, which has become one of the most important quantum resources. High-order quantum coherence in spatial domain plays a crucial role in a variety of applications, such as quantum imaging, holography and microscopy.

arxiv-2311-03034.title: Byzantine Consensus in Abstract MAC Layer
arxiv-2311-03034.creator: Lewis Tseng, Callie Sardina
arxiv-2311-03034.description: Abstract This paper studies the design of Byzantine consensus algorithms in an asynchronous single-hop network equipped with the “abstract MAC layer” [DISC09], which captures core properties of modern wireless MAC protocols. Newport [PODC14], Newport and Robinson [DISC18], and Tseng and Zhang [PODC22] study crash-tolerant consensus in the model.

arxiv-2401-00574.title: Exact WKB analysis for 𝒫𝒯 {\cal PT} symmetric quantum mechanics: Study of the Ai-Bender-Sarkar conjecture
arxiv-2401-00574.creator: Syo Kamata
arxiv-2401-00574.description: Abstract We consider exact WKB analysis to a 𝒫𝒯 {\cal PT} symmetric quantum mechanics defined by the potential, V ⁡ ( x ) = ω 2 ​ x 2 + g ​ x 2 ​ ( i ​ x ) ε = 2 V(x)=\omega^{2}x^{2}+gx^{2}(ix)^{\varepsilon=2} with ω ∈ ℝ ≥ 0 \omega\in{\mathbb{R}}_{\geq 0} , g ∈ ℝ > 0 g\in{\mathbb{R}}_{>0} .

arxiv-2405-06859.title: Reimplementation of Learning to Reweight Examples for Robust Deep Learning
arxiv-2405-06859.creator: Parth Patil, Ben Boardley, Jack Gardner, Emily Loiselle, Deerajkumar Parthipan
arxiv-2405-06859.description: Abstract Deep neural networks (DNNs) have been used to create models for many complex analysis problems like image recognition and medical diagnosis. DNNs are a popular tool within machine learning due to their ability to model complex patterns and distributions. However, the performance of these networks is highly dependent on the quality of the data used to train the models.

arxiv-2410-04727.title: Forgetting Curve: A Reliable Method for Evaluating Memorization Capability for Long-context Models
arxiv-2410-04727.creator: Xinyu Liu, Runsong Zhao, Pengcheng Huang, Chunyang Xiao, Bei Li, Jingang Wang, Tong Xiao, Jingbo Zhu
arxiv-2410-04727.description: Abstract Numerous recent works target to extend effective context length for language models and various methods, tasks and benchmarks exist to measure model’s effective memorization length. However, through thorough investigations, we find limitations for currently existing evaluations on model’s memorization capability.

arxiv-2507-10301.title: Rows and Capabilities as Modal Effects Journal: PACMPL Volume: 1 CONF 1
arxiv-2507-10301.creator: Wenhao Tang, Sam Lindley
arxiv-2507-10301.description: Abstract . Effect handlers allow programmers to model and compose computational effects modularly. Effect systems statically guarantee that all effects are handled. Several recent practical effect systems are based on either row polymorphism or capabilities. However, there remains a gap in understanding the precise relationship between effect systems with such disparate foundations.

arxiv-2509-14790.title: The Story of Sunflowers
arxiv-2509-14790.creator: Anup Rao
arxiv-2509-14790.description: Abstract Sunflowers, or Δ \Delta -systems, are a fundamental concept in combinatorics introduced by Erdős and Rado in their paper: Intersection theorems for systems of sets , J. Lond. Math. Soc. (1) 35 (1960), 85–90. A sunflower is a collection of sets where all pairs have the same intersection.

britannica-1911-espinay-timoleon-d.title: Espinay, Timoléon d' (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-espinay-timoleon-d.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-espinay-timoleon-d.description: Article 'Espinay, Timoléon d'' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 9), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. the eldest of the four sons of François d’Espinay, seigneur de Saint Luc (1554–1597), and was himself marquis de Saint Luc. In 1603 he accompanied Sully in his embassy to London. In 1622, in his capacity as vice-admiral of France, he gained some advantages over the defenders of La Rochelle, obliging the Huguenot commander, Benjamin de Rohan, seigneur de Soubise, to evacuate the islands of Ré and Oléron.

europmc-pmc8935608.title: The secretion profile of mesenchymal stem cells and potential applications in treating human diseases.
europmc-pmc8935608.creator: Han Y, Yang J, Fang J, Zhou Y, Candi E, Wang J, Hua D, Shao C, Shi Y.
europmc-pmc8935608.description: Mesenchymal stromal/stem cells (MSCs) possess multi-lineage differentiation and self-renewal potentials. MSCs-based therapies have been widely utilized for the treatment of diverse inflammatory diseases, due to the potent immunoregulatory functions of MSCs. An increasing body of

pmc-11483593.title: Overlooked Bird Extinctions in Semideciduous Atlantic Forests
pmc-11483593.creator: Vagner Cavarzere, Luís Fábio Silveira
pmc-11483593.description: The semideciduous forest is a prominent yet highly degraded phytophysiognomy within the Atlantic Forest. Historically, bird species inhabiting these forests occurred throughout central and western São Paulo state, south‐eastern Brazil, until the mid‐20th century. Many of these species have not been observed again or are nearing extinction within the state's inland forest fragments.

pmc-12592726.title: Evaluating disruption scenarios for improving downstream oil supply chain resilience and cost minimization using Monte Carlo simulation
pmc-12592726.creator: Malik Asad Hayat Awan, Afshan Naseem, Ali Ahsan, Asjad Shahzad, Mehran Ullah, Ali Safaa Sadiq
pmc-12592726.description: This study examines the impact of both random and anticipated disruptions on transportation costs within different stages of a downstream oil supply chain. Conducting a comprehensive literature review, a MILP model was developed to simulate a multifaceted refined oil supply chain, integrating refining and import facilities, storage depots, and customer demand nodes.

pmc-12648809.title: Where, when, and how to close dialysis access gaps: incorporation of geographic information system into data-driven planning
pmc-12648809.creator: Gina S Lovasi, Richard Remigio
pmc-12648809.description: Barriers to timely and consistent dialysis care include characteristics at the patient, facility, and area levels. An article by Schroeder and colleagues uses national data spanning several thousand patients served by 67 dialysis centers across 6 districts of Israel, illustrating an approach that could be extended to other health care facilities within and beyond this national setting.

pmc-12804861.title: A constitutive relationship for jointed rock mass considering the change of roughness and its application
pmc-12804861.creator: Xiaolin Li, Ge Zhang, Xinyi Chen, Chao Yang
pmc-12804861.description: The mechanical behaviors of rock joints plays a vital role in controlling the stability of layered rock slopes. Most existing constitutive models for jointed rock masses assume a constant initial roughness, ignoring its evolution during shearing and leading to inaccurate descriptions of shear deformation.

pmc-13227199.title: All-Terrain Vehicle-Related Distal Upper-Extremity Injury Rates and Patterns
pmc-13227199.creator: Janine Myint, Xinfei Miao, Subhas Gupta
pmc-13227199.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). PurposeAll-terrain vehicle (ATV)-related upper-extremity injuries are commonly seen and treated in the emergency room. Despite existing research on patterns of injuries in ATV-related trauma, there has not been a comprehensive study on patterns of upper-extremity injuries from ATV use.

pmc-13234018.title: Occult fractures in low-energy trauma—A retrospective forensic case series
pmc-13234018.creator: Giuseppe Basile, Vittorio Bolcato, Luca Bianco Prevot, Michela Basile, Lucio Di Mauro, Livio Pietro Tronconi
pmc-13234018.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundOccult fractures (OFs) are inapparent fractures on initial plain radiographs, retrospectively diagnosed through second level imaging. The reasons for further diagnostic investigation may be the persistence of symptoms, or various personal needs, including insurance related. OFs, typically associated with low-energy trauma, are often underdiagnosed in the acute phase; however, they are relevant in the medico-legal field, as failure to identify them or delays in diagnosis and treatment may determine disability and give rise to complaint.

pmc-13372598.title: Smart thyroid-regulated drug delivery systems: a review of intelligent biosensor-integrated therapeutics for precision thyroxine replacement
pmc-13372598.creator: Rahul Ingle, Gajanan M. Sonwane
pmc-13372598.description: Levothyroxine (L-T4) replacement therapy has remained the standard treatment for post-thyroidectomy hypothyroidism since the mid-twentieth century. The drug works, but the delivery method has a basic flaw: it cannot adjust. A patient swallows the same dose every morning regardless of whether she is pregnant, fighting a fever, fasting, or sleeping.

pmc-13443630.title: The role of adult romantic attachment in long-term childhood cancer survivors’ social relationships and help-seeking
pmc-13443630.creator: Lea-Bianka Tröster, Hannah Marie Hermann, Manfred E Beutel, Tamara Schwinn, Judith Hirschmiller, Jörg Wiltink, Elmar Brähler, Hiltrud Merzenich, Jörg Faber, Philipp S Wild, Mareike Ernst
pmc-13443630.description: Childhood cancer survivors (CCS) are at risk for health-related and social challenges that can extend far into adulthood. However, CCS’ trajectories are heterogeneous. As a potential influencing factor, the present work investigated adult romantic attachment in conjunction with their relationship perceptions and experiences and help-seeking behavior.

pmc-13518909.title: Exploring the panel and country wise effect of circular economy on environmental sustainability across six leading circular economies
pmc-13518909.creator: Na Wei, Muhammad Imran, Hui Zhang, Abad Alzuman, Xuebing Zhang, Xiao Niu, Misbah Aslam

pmc-13534187.title: Overcoming urea and nitrate inhibition of biological nitrogen fixation in Azotobacter vinelandii versus natural tolerance in Gluconacetobacter diazotrophicus
pmc-13534187.creator: Donnen Yong, Brett M Barney
pmc-13534187.description: Nitrogen is often a limiting nutrient for agricultural crops. Most microbes also require an external fixed-nitrogen source for optimal growth. Even for microbes capable of biological nitrogen fixation (BNF), it is generally the case that they will regulate their metabolism to prioritize assimilation of fixed-nitrogen.

pmc-13586472.title: Collaborative governance for creative health: initial programme theories for collaborating across sectors and disciplines
pmc-13586472.creator: C Dayson, E Lockley, S Trentham-Black, L Robertshaw, S Hampshaw, M Barclay, S Clough, E Holding, E Bennett, C Froggatt, C Malaney, E Taylor, T Begum
pmc-13586472.description: Aims:To understand (1) how collaborative governance for creative health is being enacted in different health and social care systems across the UK and (2) why collaborative governance for creative health was needed in these systems and the factors that enable it to be effective.
